figures.finding: The minimum age for admission to employment in Costa Rica is fifteen, set by the Children and Adolescents Code (Law No. 7739), art. 78, which overrides the Labour Code's older articles 88 and 89; art. 92 absolutely prohibits hiring children under fifteen.
figures.applies: Costa Rica; the State's report of 2009 on the Código de la Niñez y la Adolescencia.

sources.said: the minimum age for admission to employment is 15 years, as stipulated in article 78 of the Children and Adolescents Code, not in articles 88 and 89 of the Labour Code.
in article 92, it absolutely prohibits the hiring of children under 15 years old

figures.finding: No exception for performing work is reported: the Children and Adolescents Code's absolute bar on hiring under fifteen is the general rule that reaches a child performer's employment, and the same reaches a young writer or director.
figures.applies: Costa Rica; a reading from the reported bar; whether PANI or the Ministry authorise performances wasn't read.

sources.said: it absolutely prohibits the hiring of children under 15 years old and establishes regulations governing own-account work and family work.

figures.finding: A minor under fifteen is absolutely incapable of binding himself by contract; a minor over fifteen's own contracts are relatively void, annullable at his representative's or his own request on majority, unless he claimed to be of age with reasonable grounds for belief. No set-aside of earnings is in the code.

sources.said: El menor de quince años es persona absolutamente incapaz para obligarse por actos o contratos que personalmente realice, salvo lo dispuesto sobre matrimonio.

Los actos o contratos que el mayor de quince años realice por sí mismo, siendo todavía menor, serán relativamente nulos y podrán anularse a solicitud de su representante o del mismo menor cuando alcance la mayoridad
